CustomField.description: Total Received to Date. Sum of Total Paid Transaction Amount (TotalPaidTransactionAmount) across every Gift Commitment linked to this Opportunity by the standard Opportunity relationship. Maintained by the DLRS roll-up Grant Total Received to Date (dlrs__LookupRollupSummary2) - it cannot be a native roll-up summary because Gift Commitment is joined to Opportunity by lookup, not master-detail. The commitment's paid total is itself maintained by NPC Gift Commitment coordination, so this reflects reimbursements settled as of that processing. Do not edit by hand.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Total reimbursement received to date, summed from Total Paid Transaction Amount on this grant's Gift Commitments. Calculated - do not edit.
CustomField.label: Total Received to Date
